visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, slightly messy hair is looking down, his face partially illuminated. He wears a light-colored turtleneck sweater and a thick silver chain necklace. In the background, a shelf filled with various books is visible under warm indoor lighting. A black caption box with white text appears at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a mobile screen recording of a YouTube Studio analytics page. A bright blue bar chart displays a sharp upward trend in real-time traffic. Various categories of traffic sources are listed below the graph in Traditional Chinese. (3) The video returns to the young man, who now looks directly into the camera with a subtle smirk before another cut occurs. (4) A cinematic clip shows a man with short brown hair in a dark, neon-lit room with flashes of blue and red light. He has bruises on his forehead and nose. He initially looks around with a stunned expression, then begins to rhythmically sway his head and shoulders to the music. Blurred figures dance in the background of the club environment.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Data Evidence -> Emotional Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously celebrate a sudden viral spike in YouTube channel traffic. The creator presents their initial reaction, shows a real-time analytic dashboard as proof of high views (comparing it to the 'glory days' of five years prior), and uses a famous clip of Jon Hamm dancing to express their excitement and relief.
